integrity: Integer and rational assertions in the proof are checked by the accompanying standard-library verification script; no external proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-order theorem restricted to double stars with two leaves at one center and b>=2 leaves at the other; historical priority is provisional. Finite computation corroborates, but does not replace, the proof.
title: A sharp parity-dependent real-zero transition for sink polynomials of double-star trees
